name: Lefkara lace embroidery piece
about: Lefkara lace is a traditional Cypriot needlework style from the village of Lefkara, and it is closely tied to the island's craft heritage around Nicosia.
tip: Check that the piece is hand-embroidered before you buy it.

name: Commandaria
where: City wine shops or Alphamega supermarket
about: Commandaria is a traditional Cypriot dessert wine, often described as one of the oldest named wines in the world, and it is a local favorite to bring home.
tip: Check the label for the country of origin to make sure the bottle is genuine Cypriot Commandaria.
